scope: Independent visual QA of ALL26currently-whitelisted historical subjects, eight source images each208views. Diagnostic resizing/compositing only; original art and runtime not modified.
method: Viewed seven1840pxcontact sheets at original resolution and enlarged dedicated8-view diagnostics for gazebo and timber garage. Did not equate PNG/alpha/hash validity with visual correctness.

blockingFindings.subject: world:gazebo
blockingFindings.reason: Repeated normal-camera/front entrance inNE/SE/SW. Exclude from true8reuse until genuine corner redraw.

blockingFindings.subject: golf:clubhouse-shanty
blockingFindings.reason: Owner explicitly rejected this blue-tarp/goblin-shack style; replacement1950sbudget clubhouse is already in progress. Do not call this historical artwork a completed replacement.

importantLimits: Contact-scale review is sufficient to catch repeated camera/facade errors but does not certify exact8degree yaw, all fine roof/window positions, anchors or physical pixels/metre.

Most historical art has window/neon/lamp glow. These cannot be represented as newly generated late-afternoon daylight art. The earlier only-from-now-on instruction is not retroactive approval to regenerate all historic art.
Several haunted/rundown and workshop-subject identity/style questions are recorded individually; no unrelated candidate has been silently approved.
No image generation, runtime edits, full tests, build or server were started.
